title: Top 10 Refer and Earn Apps Without KYC in India 2026
summary: Top 10 refer and earn apps without KYC in India 2026 — what no-KYC referral really means, how each app's rewards work, and which pays Rs 500-2,000 per referral.
body_markdown:
Refer and earn is the simplest genuine way to make money from your phone — share an app with a friend, earn a reward when they join. But the phrase people actually search is " **refer and earn apps without KYC** ", and it deserves an honest explanation before any list, because apps that promise money with no verification at all are usually the ones that never pay.


## What Does "Refer and Earn Without KYC" Actually Mean?


KYC (Know Your Customer) is the identity verification — PAN, Aadhaar, sometimes a video check — that regulated financial products require. "Refer and earn without KYC" means one of two genuine things:


- **You can start referring without completing product KYC yourself.** Example: on most investment apps you must open your own KYC-verified demat account before you're allowed to refer one. On a distribution platform like GroMo, you can refer demat accounts, credit cards, and loans *without owning those products yourself* — a simple one-time registration and you're referring the same day.
- **The referral itself needs no paperwork from you.** UPI and shopping apps like Paytm, PhonePe, Google Pay, CashKaro, and Meesho let you share a referral link straight from the app — no documents, no forms, rewards to your wallet or bank.


One honest note that protects you: *your friend* may still complete KYC for whatever they sign up for (a bank account or demat account legally requires it — that's what makes it real). "Without KYC" describes **your side of the referral** , not a promise that regulated products magically skip verification. Any app claiming that is one to avoid.


With that clear, here are the 10 best refer and earn apps without KYC in India for 2026 (see also our roundup of[legit refer and earn apps](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-earn-2026-legit-apps/) ) — with how referring works and what each actually pays.


## 1. GroMo — The Highest-Paying Referral App


**Reward range: ₹500–₹2,000+ per approved referral | Payout: to your bank account**


GroMo is refer-and-earn at a completely different pay grade. Instead of ₹50–₹200 app-install bonuses, you refer real financial products from[India's leading banks](https://gromo.in/blog/is-gromo-real-or-fake/) — and the banks pay real commissions:


- **[Credit card refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-refer-and-earn/) :** ₹1,000–₹2,000+ per approved card — this is where the "refer and earn ₹1,000" searches actually come true.
- **Savings account referrals:** help a friend open a zero-balance account digitally in minutes.
- **[Personal loan refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/personal-loan-refer-and-earn/) :** commissions when someone in your circle genuinely needs a loan and their application is approved.
- **[Demat refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/demat-account-refer-and-earn/) — without opening your own:** on typical investment apps you must first open your own KYC-verified demat account to unlock referrals. With GroMo, you can refer demat accounts *without that product KYC* — no need to become an investor yourself to earn from investor referrals.


**How to refer on GroMo:**


1. Download the GroMo app and complete the free one-time registration.
2. Finish the short in-app training for the product you want to refer.
3. Pick a product — credit card, savings account, loan, or demat — and share its application link on WhatsApp.
4. Your friend applies digitally; track the application status inside the app.
5. The commission is credited after the bank approves the application.


No targets, no fixed hours — your network is the only requirement.


## 2. Paytm Refer and Earn


**Reward range: ₹50–₹150 per referral, campaign-based | Payout: cashback to wallet/UPI**


India's veteran refer-and-earn program. Rewards trigger when your friend installs Paytm and completes their first UPI transaction or payment.


**How to refer on Paytm without KYC:**


1. Open Paytm and tap your profile icon.
2. Select "Refer & Win" / "Refer a Friend".
3. Share your referral link on WhatsApp.
4. The reward credits after your friend's first qualifying transaction.


Offers rotate frequently, so check the banner for the current amount.


## 3. PhonePe Refer and Earn


**Reward range: ₹50–₹200 per referral, campaign-based | Payout: wallet/bank cashback**


PhonePe's referral rewards fire when the invited friend registers with your link and makes their first UPI money transfer.


**How to refer on PhonePe without KYC:**


1. Open PhonePe and go to your profile.
2. Tap "Refer & Get".
3. Share the invite link with a friend who is new to PhonePe.
4. The reward credits once they register and make their first UPI transfer.


Rewards sometimes come as scratch cards, so amounts vary within the range.


## 4. Google Pay (GPay) Refer and Earn


**Reward range: ₹50–₹201 per referral, campaign-based | Payout: directly to bank via UPI**


GPay historically runs some of the most generous UPI referral offers (the famous ₹201-per-friend campaigns), paid straight to your linked bank account.


**How to refer on Google Pay without KYC:**


1. Open GPay and tap your profile.
2. Select "Invite friends, get rewards".
3. Share your code or invite link.
4. The reward credits to your bank after your friend makes their first payment.


Campaigns pause and resume — the invite screen always shows the live offer.


## 5. BHIM UPI Referral Campaigns


**Reward range: campaign-dependent (historically ₹25–₹100) | Payout: bank account**


NPCI's own BHIM app runs government-backed referral and cashback campaigns periodically rather than continuously — when active, they are as legitimate as it gets.


**How to refer on BHIM without KYC:**


1. Open BHIM and go to the menu.
2. Look for the active "Refer a friend" or cashback banner.
3. Share your referral with your friend.
4. The campaign reward credits to your bank per the live terms.


If no campaign is live you'll see no banner — check back rather than trusting third-party "BHIM offer" websites.


## 6. CashKaro Refer and Earn


**Reward: 10% lifetime commission on friends' cashback earnings + join bonuses | Payout: bank/UPI/gift cards**


CashKaro pays cashback on shopping via Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and 1,500+ sites — and its referral program pays you 10% of your friends' cashback *forever* . That structure rewards patient referrers: a few active shoppers compound into steady monthly income.


**How to refer on CashKaro:**


1. Open the app and go to the "Refer & Earn" tab.
2. Share your referral link.
3. Your friend signs up free with email/phone — no KYC — and shops through the app.
4. Your 10% override on their cashback accrues automatically, forever.


Sign-up bonus campaigns (often ₹100–₹500) rotate through the year — the "refer and earn ₹500" offers you see advertised are usually these.


## 7. EarnKaro — Referral Earning as a Business


**Reward: affiliate commission on every sale + 10% of referred users' earnings | Payout: bank transfer**


EarnKaro (CashKaro's sibling) turns anyone into an affiliate with zero KYC and zero investment: convert any product link into your earning link, share deals in WhatsApp groups, and earn commission on each sale. Its refer-and-earn layer adds 10% of whatever the people you invite earn.


**How to refer on EarnKaro:**


1. Open the app and tap "Refer & Earn".
2. Share your invite link with people who share deals.
3. Separately, convert product links into profit links and share them daily to deal groups.
4. Earn commission on every sale, plus 10% of your invitees' earnings.


Consistent deal-sharers report ₹3,000–₹15,000 monthly — it pairs naturally with GroMo since the audiences overlap.


## 8. Meesho Refer and Earn


**Reward: commission on referred resellers' sales (campaigns vary) | Payout: bank account**


Meesho's referral program targets its reseller network: invite someone who starts reselling, and you earn a percentage of their sales in their early months, per the live campaign terms.


**How to refer on Meesho:**


1. Open the app and go to your profile.
2. Tap "Refer & Earn".
3. Share your code with someone who will genuinely resell.
4. Earn a share of their sales in their early months, per the live campaign terms.


Best used with homemakers and students building side income — one active reseller beats fifty dead installs.


## 9. Amazon Pay UPI Referral Offers


**Reward range: ₹25–₹125 per referral, campaign-based | Payout: Amazon Pay balance**


Amazon periodically pays for bringing friends to Amazon Pay UPI, and the balance is instantly usable across Amazon — practical even when amounts are modest.


**How to refer on Amazon:**


1. Open the Amazon app and go to Amazon Pay.
2. Look for the UPI invite banner.
3. Share your link with a friend.
4. The reward credits to Amazon Pay balance after they set up UPI and transact.


Like all UPI programs, live offers vary by user and season.


## 10. Shopsy (by Flipkart) Refer and Earn


**Reward: campaign bonuses + reseller commissions | Payout: bank account**


Flipkart's reselling app runs referral campaigns for bringing new users and resellers, stacking neatly with its zero-investment reselling income itself.


**How to refer on Shopsy:**


1. Open the app and go to your profile.
2. Tap "Refer & Earn".
3. Share the link with someone who will actually resell.
4. Campaign bonuses and reseller-linked commissions credit to your bank.


As with Meesho, reseller-linked rewards pay far more than install bonuses.


## How Referral Reward Systems Actually Work (Read Before You Share)


- **Qualifying action:** almost no app pays for a bare install. Rewards trigger on a first transaction, first sale, or an approved application. Tell your friend what completes the referral — that one sentence doubles your success rate.
- **Reward types:** flat bonuses (UPI apps), lifetime overrides (CashKaro/EarnKaro's 10%), and product commissions (GroMo — the largest amounts). Bigger rewards always track bigger, more genuine actions.
- **Caps and expiry:** UPI campaigns cap referrals per user and rotate monthly; commission platforms like GroMo have no such caps because banks want unlimited customers.
- **The golden rule:** refer only what you'd use yourself. Your contact list is a one-time asset — spend it on products that make you look good.


## Which Referral App Should You Start With?


- **Want the biggest per-referral payouts (₹500–₹2,000+)?** GroMo — credit card, personal loan, and demat referrals without product KYC of your own.
- **Want instant small wins?** Paytm, PhonePe, GPay — share with the friends who don't yet use UPI.
- **Want compounding income?** CashKaro + EarnKaro's lifetime 10% overrides.
- **Know aspiring resellers?** Meesho and Shopsy referrals convert best there.
- **The smart stack:** UPI apps for quick rewards this week, EarnKaro for deal-sharing habit, GroMo as the serious earner — together they cover every contact in your phone.


Refer and earn without KYC is real, legal, and worth doing — as long as you match the app to the person and stay with programs run by companies you can verify. Start with the one that fits your network today; if you want the version where a single referral can pay more than a month of app bonuses,[start with GroMo](https://gromo.in/?ref=gromo.in) — free registration, bank-paid commissions, and referrals for products your friends genuinely need.


## FAQ: Refer and Earn Apps Without KYC


**What is the best refer and earn app without KYC in India?**


GroMo pays the most per referral — Rs 1,000-2,000+ for an approved credit card and Rs 500-1,500 for accounts and loans — because rewards come from banks as commissions, not marketing budgets. You register once, free, and can refer credit cards, personal loans, and even demat accounts without opening your own demat first. For quick small rewards, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Paytm are the best UPI options.


**Which app gives refer and earn 500 without KYC?**


Rs 500-level referral rewards come from two places: sign-up bonus campaigns on cashback apps like CashKaro (their offers often hit Rs 100-500 per friend during promotions), and commission platforms like GroMo, where account and loan referrals routinely pay Rs 500-1,500 and credit cards pay Rs 1,000+. UPI apps rarely cross Rs 201 per referral — bigger rewards always track bigger genuine actions.


**Can I really earn Rs 1,000 per referral?**


Yes — but only where the referred action is valuable to a business. GroMo's credit card referrals pay Rs 1,000-2,000+ per approved application because banks pay serious customer-acquisition commissions. No install-bonus app pays Rs 1,000 for a download; if one claims to, expect withdrawal problems. Check the live per-product commission inside the GroMo app before sharing.


**Do refer and earn apps really pay without KYC?**


The genuine ones do — for your side of the referral. Sharing a link on Paytm, GPay, CashKaro, or Meesho needs no documents, and GroMo needs only a simple one-time registration, not product KYC. Your friend completes whatever verification their new account legally requires — that is normal and is exactly what makes the reward real. Avoid apps that promise verified financial products with no KYC for anyone: that is a scam pattern.


**How do I withdraw refer and earn money?**


It depends on the app's payout rail: GroMo, EarnKaro, Meesho, and BHIM pay to your bank account; Paytm and PhonePe credit wallet or UPI cashback; Google Pay pays straight to your linked bank; Amazon pays into Amazon Pay balance; CashKaro offers bank transfer or gift cards. Minimum withdrawal thresholds and reward validity vary — check each app's payments section.


## Disclaimer


Nothing here is a guarantee of income. Referral offers, reward amounts, and program terms change frequently and vary by user, campaign, and season — **always check the current refer-and-earn offer inside each app's own referral section before sharing** ; the app's live terms are the only ones that apply. GroMo commissions are set by the partner banks and financial institutions, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications — check the live commission in the GroMo app before relying on any figure.


Everything above is general information, not financial advice. All app names and trademarks belong to their respective owners. Referred customers must complete whatever verification their chosen product legally requires, and no legitimate platform ever asks you to pay a fee or share an OTP to earn.
